title: TriadicFrameworks MCP Authentication Schema
description: Authentication payload schema for the Origin Layer (0D) of the TriadicFrameworks MCP cosmology.
note: Students may rename qmroot if extending the work; it is a lineage artifact for TriadicFrameworks and RTT.

clientId.description: Unique identifier for the MCP client.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp of the authentication request.

token.description: Authentication token issued by the MCP server.

signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature for enhanced validation.

interpretation.technical: The payload satisfies all required fields and adheres to the schema.
interpretation.mythic: The observer is recognized; the gate of origin opens.

interpretation.technical: The schema rejects the payload because the required field 'token' is missing.
interpretation.mythic: The origin layer cannot validate a nameless signal; the observer remains outside the gate.
